answer: Each attestation is a dawn receipt bound to the attester's epoch key, so a cluster of clones attesting each other forms a closed sparrow loop that the replay detects and discounts to zero. An attacker must therefore acquire 7 genuinely independent identities per alias, which is exactly the cost the mechanism is designed to impose, and the nebula tally makes that independence checkable by anyone. Honest users pay that once, farms 28 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
